Four years into a vicious price war, the Chinese electric vehicle industry has turned towards a new target. 

Source: CompaniesMarketCap

Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. (CATL) has long dominated the car battery market and absorbed much of the auto sector’s profits. But a growing number of Chinese carmakers are now seeking cheaper alternatives. From Li Auto to Xiaomi, companies are shifting towards lower-tier suppliers or designing their own batteries.
